svg.text: A writable control and a locked one look identical

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So it has to be shown on the control, never left inside the adapter. If only the adapter knows, you drag a dead slider and nothing happens.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One more thing is easy to miss: a refusal is a crossing too, and it is recorded — "never tried" and "tried and refused" are different facts.
